name: BridgeNode
description: Pay-per-request AI inference via x402 on Solana USDC — OpenAI-compatible chat completions. No API keys, no accounts; BridgeNode sponsors gas fees.

baseUrl.description: BridgeNode OpenAI-compatible base URL (default https://bridgenode.cc/v1; HTTPS + bridgenode.cc only).

rpcUrl.description: Solana RPC URL used for payment settlement (default https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com).

maxUsdcPerTx.description: Max USDC per transaction (default "1"; exactly "0" disables the cap).

walletPrivateKey.description: Agent Solana wallet private key (base58) — prefer env SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY or a SecretRef.
